caption: The video captures a static close-up of a decorated Christmas tree, where two small lantern-shaped ornaments hang from a thin wire strung across the frame. The physical arrangement of dark green pine needles, red tinsel, and out-of-focus colored bokeh lights remains fixed throughout. The illuminated panels inside the hanging lanterns cycle between two color states. The center-right lantern shifts from a warm orange glow to a cool bright white-blue, while the left lantern changes from orange to green. The surrounding background lights shimmer faintly in brightness without moving position. No camera pan or zoom occurs, keeping the framing constant as the color cycle continues.
